name: Desire
overview: Scripture reveals that true desire is rooted in wholeheartedly seeking the LORD, as Deuteronomy 4:29 emphasizes the promise of finding God when pursued with all heart and soul. The Psalms consistently reflect a heart devoted to praising and seeking God's presence, demonstrating that spiritual desires lead to satisfaction and eternal life (Psalms 9:1; 22:26). Moreover, waiting on God and seeking His truth are expressions of a righteous desire that aligns the believer with God's salvation and justice (Psalms 17:1; 24:6; 25:5). These verses collectively show that godly desire is not self-centered but focused on God’s face and His truth.
